title: Retain the public Boolean compatibility shim after live-caller audit

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Audit whether boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold is now only historical baggage after GPU-71/72 or remains a live compatibility contract. Do not remove or deprecate public API in this packet and do not create another projection surface.

audit.production_internal_callers: Repository exact-name search plus branch-specific inspection found no production caller beyond relation_projection.py itself and the package re-export in daedalus/twin/__init__.py.
audit.public_package_contract: The symbol is explicitly re-exported in daedalus.twin.__all__, and .github/workflows/fourfold-v2.yml imports it in the Verify public package API step. Removing it now would therefore be an intentional public compatibility break rather than ordinary gardening.
live_test_and_probe_callers: tests/twin/test_fourfold_relation_projection.py directly pins the historical single-relation call shape while now inheriting canonical compiler semantics.
tests/twin/test_tensor_forest_cost_probe.py uses the shim to construct Boolean CSR relation blocks in the diagnostic-only Forest/Tensor cost probe.
tests/twin/test_tensor_heldout_csr_probe.py uses the shim for the held-out diagnostic CSR arm.
The Fourfold/Tensor workflow runs tests/twin and separately checks the exported symbol as public package API.
audit.documentation: docs/wiki/architecture/twin.md still names boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold as a Twin module surface. Its wording predates GPU-71/72 and should be aligned later so compile_relation_blocks is unambiguously the implementation owner while the shim is described only as compatibility.

decision.summary: The alias is not dead historical baggage: it is an intentionally exported public call shape, is checked by CI as package API, and remains used by compatibility and diagnostic probe surfaces. Keep the already-thin shim. Do not add a deprecation wrapper, alias registry or second projector merely to make future removal easier.
decision.gardener_note: GPU-71/72 already removed the duplicated implementation and diagnostic authority. GPU-73 stops the deletion campaign at the correct boundary: one small compatibility facade is cheaper and safer than a breaking removal or another compatibility layer.

verification.notes: This packet intentionally changes no production or test behavior. Verification is exact source/blob inspection of the public export, CI API contract, compatibility tests and diagnostic probe callers. GPU-72 remains the immediately preceding tested code state; GPU-73 does not relabel that evidence as a new full-suite result.

bounded_next_step: GPU-74 only: repair the remaining Twin architecture documentation drift so compile_relation_blocks is named as the sole relation-projection implementation owner and boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold only as a retained public compatibility facade. Audit diagnostic probes separately before changing their construction path because batching signatures would change measured construction semantics. Do not remove the public shim, create a second compatibility layer, or widen claims.
